acceptance_findings.finding: All seven exact archived manifests and 110 exports match their preserved private packets. All 123 admission artifacts match; 44 graph inputs have exact public routes, while six separately supplied primary inputs are not redistributed. Both prior and corrected logical/cost packets remain separate.

All 34 prior non-main function ASTs and all old main validation calls are unchanged; the only added function is check_affine_dag. Top-level imports/configuration are unchanged. Existing affine proof and measurement checks still pass.

The public guard recomputes disjoint-span conservation in all three extraction variants and NFC/NFKC, checks 120 document metric cells and 5820 owner cells, and verifies 119 individual plus 99 source-row plus four complete/additional unions. Logical predecessor unions become exclusive owner unions before summation; parent displays are not charged again.

The acquisition view pays every owner of the complete common paper, full required-code appendix and complete application. Unused common results, front matter and references stay paid. No cross-topic discount or generic proof-node counting factor enters.

All six mathematical programs are included as whole files. The raw alternative removes printed CODE costs before adding the corresponding full raw source costs, so neither programs nor shared appendix context are charged twice. Two drivers and one diagnostic, plus three Lean source files, remain separate.

The exact one-source/33-record contract is unchanged, including sign and cross-reference qualifications, exclusion of general Problem 1.1, independent Table 1 census and seed uniqueness, and no new equal-label question credit. Nine scoped Lean declarations remain partial evidence; no complete source formalization is asserted.

The whole written factor remains 32767/41708, approximately 0.786; the complete printed-program factor is 32767/58958, approximately 0.556, or 32767/58390, approximately 0.561, for the raw alternative. The 32767/22638 application factor, approximately 1.447, is explicitly conditional on already acquiring the whole common paper and all six programs. These existing numerical claims were not remeasured or modified in this publication.

The revised formula defines P(v) as a node’s passage-owner set, takes calligraphic P(t) as their union over the prerequisite closure, and sums c(p) over that union. This correctly replaces summing overlapping displayed node weights. Missing external proof and graphics costs remain unknown; full-document costs are not replaced by selected proof costs.

All 125 local documentation links checked in the main and new topic readers resolve. The new publication README, complete changed protocol text and all seven current protocol pages were read. No clipping, overflow or missing mathematical symbols were observed. Exact earlier graph and two-page reader visuals reuse the accepted root cost review; no browser test is claimed.

Seventeen in-memory data/integrity alterations are rejected with disk-byte checks still active. Three additional boundary controls reject undeclared additions under the topic prefix, undeclared review exports and scientific edits. The unmodified guard passes again after the controls.
